mmol/L.notes: HealthKit needs glucose's molar mass to convert mg/dL and mmol/L

kcal/d.notes: Basal metabolic rate (decision #21); HealthKit has no rate type for it

ios.notes: Before iOS 18 the same raw values were HKCategoryValueMenstrualFlow (deprecated)

android.notes: RESULT_HIGH is 'a rise in estrogen or luteinizing hormone' (T08), so an LH-driven HIGH also reads as estrogenSurge

ios.notes: asleep is the deprecated Asleep (1) before iOS 16; core, deep and REM need iOS 16 (HealthKit raises an exception for them on iOS 15, decision #59)

sleepStage.notes: 04-type-mapping §4a. HealthKit inBed spans the night and overlaps the asleep stages; Health Connect stages don't overlap (decision #61)

mindfulnessSessionType.notes: HealthKit mindful sessions have no type

ios.notes: HealthKit segments have no type: a pause segment is a pause event followed by a resume event (raw values 1 and 2); any other segment is a segment event (7) without a type (decision #67)

workoutSegmentType.notes: 04-type-mapping §4c. Health Connect only lets a session hold the segment types its exercise type allows (workoutSegments)

cycling.notes: iOS: indoor metadata absent or false

guidedBreathing.notes: iOS records breathing as mindful sessions

hockey.notes: Any hockey; nearest on Android: iceHockey, rollerHockey

rowing.notes: iOS: indoor metadata absent or false

running.notes: iOS: indoor metadata absent or false

skatingSports.notes: Android: iceSkating is its own type

stairClimbingMachine.notes: HealthKit stairClimbing is the stair stepper; stairs is climbing real stairs

surfing.notes: HealthKit surfingSports includes kite and wind surfing

swimming.notes: iOS: no swimming location; Android has only pool and open water

other.notes: Reads of a native value with no unified id return other, the raw value in native.value

workoutSegments.notes: ExerciseSegment.isCompatibleWith in connect-client 1.1.0 (its static sets, read by reflection): a segment fits an activity in anySegment, a segment type in anyActivity, or the activity's own list; the record's constructor throws otherwise (decision #67)

android.computed: true when a MenstruationPeriodRecord from the same data origin starts on the record's local date, false when one covers it but started earlier, absent otherwise (decision #16)

ios.notes: HealthKit requires the cycle-start key on every sample; Apple Health writes false even on day 1 (T07)
Derived from flow samples on read, expanded into per-day flow samples on write (03-architecture, decision #29)

android.notes: Ends inside the last local day on write, read end-exclusive (decision #30)

ios.notes: Written by Apple Watch. HealthKit disallows sharing it: requesting share access raises NSInvalidArgumentException (T19, decision #43)

android.notes: Baseline plus a list of timed deltas, so it stays separate from wristTemperature (absolute values)

ios.notes: Written by Apple's cycle-deviation detection. HealthKit disallows sharing it: requesting share access raises NSInvalidArgumentException (T19, decision #43)

types.notes: Always aggregate: samples from phone and watch overlap
Energy over an interval. Android has no such record: aggregate() serves it from basal metabolic rate (decision #21)
Health Connect stores series records; reads give one sample per point
One sample with systolic and diastolic: an HKCorrelation of the two quantity types on iOS (decision #54)
Water drunk over an interval; an instant on iOS is allowed, Android needs an end after the start

segments.ios: Workout events: a pause segment is a pause event and its resume event, any other a segment event
segments.android: ExerciseSessionRecord.segments; inside the session, no overlaps, types the exercise type allows

laps.ios: Lap workout events; length in HKMetadataKeyLapLength
laps.android: ExerciseSessionRecord.laps; inside the session, no overlaps, length 0-1,000,000 m

activities.ios: HKWorkoutActivity (iOS 16), each with its own activity type

ios.notes: HKWorkout, written with HKWorkoutBuilder. Totals are the statistics of the samples associated with it; written totals are active energy and distance samples added to the builder, split between pauses, distance in the activity's ios.distance type (decisions #67-#68)

android.notes: Health Connect has no totals on a session: they're the session app's active calories and distance records over the session; written totals are such records (decision #67). Reads look back 24 hours, as for sleep sessions; duration is EXERCISE_DURATION_TOTAL, session time minus pause and rest segments (decision #69)

types.notes: title and notes are Android only, activities iOS only

stages.ios: One sleepAnalysis category sample per stage; inBed spans the session and overlaps the others
stages.android: SleepSessionRecord.stages; stages sit inside the session and don't overlap

ios.notes: Derived from sleepAnalysis samples on read (per source, split by gaps longer than an hour), written as one sample per stage plus an inBed sample spanning the session (decision #64). aggregate() duration is time asleep, overlaps between apps counted once (decision #65)

android.notes: One SleepSessionRecord per session, stages as its stages (decision #66). Reads look back 24 hours so sessions that start before the range still overlap it

types.notes: title and notes are Android only
Android: title and notes read as hc.title / hc.notes metadata. No aggregate: connect-client 1.1.0 has no platform mapping for MINDFULNESS_DURATION_TOTAL, so Android 14+ rejects it (decision #63)
